name: Image
summary: One picture, filling the slide or shown whole, under an optional title.
description: Let one picture carry the message. A photo close to the frame's shape fills it with a light crop (at most 7.5% off each edge); any other picture, a diagram or an SVG is shown whole at its own proportions (fit auto). Add a short title or caption to explain what the audience should notice. For a full-bleed crop of any picture, set the image block's fit to cover; to never crop, contain.
